text: Setting clear goals is essential for any successful project. One popular method is using SMART goals, which means goals that are Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant, and Time-bound. This approach helps teams stay focused and track their progress. It is also important to define milestones, which are key points in the project timeline, and deliverables, the actual results or products you must complete. Finally, make sure all stakeholders agree on the goals from the beginning. When everyone shares the same understanding, the project is much more likely to succeed.
